## Objective
Fix all 13 bugs from the PegSlam tracker.

### T1: User deletion counter not updating (Bug #1)
- **File**: `server/mongodb-storage.ts`, `server/routes.ts`
- **Fix**: When admin deletes participant, decrement `pegsBooked` on competition

### T2: Manual add users shows paid (Bug #2)
- **File**: `server/routes.ts` (admin manual add route)
- **Fix**: When admin manually adds angler, set payment status to "not paid"

### T3: Sponsor weight calculation - SKIP per user request

### T4: Stripe payment not reflecting (Bug #4)
- **File**: `server/routes.ts` (confirm-payment-and-join)
- **Fix**: After payment success, update payment status and ensure participant is registered

### T5: Slider size (Bug #5)
- **File**: `client/src/pages/admin-competitions.tsx`, admin slider upload
- **Fix**: Add note/recommendation for optimal slider dimensions (1920x600 desktop, 768x400 mobile)

### T6: Fish image upload in admin (Bug #6)
- **File**: `server/routes.ts`, `client/src/pages/admin-competitions.tsx`, `shared/schema.ts`
- **Fix**: Add `fishImageUrl` field to leaderboard entries; admin can upload fish photo when adding weight

### T7: Contact email (Bug #7)
- **File**: `server/email.ts`
- **Fix**: Change `CONTACT_EMAIL` default to `Ian.justo@pegslam.com`

### T8: Admin login (Bug #8)
- **File**: `server/routes.ts`
- **Fix**: Already partially fixed - verify session persistence works

### T9: Sponsor link prefixed with pegslam.com (Bug #9)
- **File**: `client/src/pages/sponsors.tsx`, `client/src/components/sponsor-logo-slider.tsx`
- **Fix**: Detect if website URL is already absolute, don't prefix

### T10: Replace Twitter with TikTok (Bug #10)
- **File**: `client/src/components/footer.tsx`, `client/src/components/sponsor-logo-slider.tsx`, `client/src/pages/admin-sponsors.tsx`
- **Fix**: Replace Twitter icon with TikTok, update labels

### T11: Phone number mandatory (Bug #11)
- **File**: `shared/schema.ts`, `client/src/pages/register.tsx`, `client/src/components/edit-profile-dialog.tsx`
- **Fix**: Make `mobileNumber` required, show on profile edit but keep private from public view

### T12: Gallery UI improvement (Bug #12)
- **File**: `client/src/pages/gallery.tsx`
- **Fix**: Improve layout - masonry grid, better spacing, larger images

### T13: Leaderboard text overflow (Bug #13)
- **File**: `client/src/pages/leaderboard.tsx`, `client/src/components/leaderboard-table.tsx`
- **Fix**: Fix text overflow, ensure responsive layout

```javascript
<<Route path="/admin/login" component={AdminLogin} />
```
